segments.text: Most of the people suffer from imperfection received from past life karmas excessive accumulation of imperfection.
NOTE : Accumulation of dosh creates “shraap” whereas accumulation of shraap creates “dosh”.
If positive exists then negative should also exists.
If good exists then bad also exists.
If shraap exists then vardaan should also exists.
To understand this we take a true case study of a person called named A, which stays near Gaziabad a city near Haryana border, whose family acquired curse & vardaan simultaneously in his alive state.
A Case Study

A’s grandfather was seeking help as their parents lost their vision in an accident, he visited multiple doctors, tantriks, occultist or saints who practice black magic to get a cure but none responded. After a long search one of a shamshaan (cremation) saint adviced that a person can only get his vision through amrit sidhi.

He became his disciple and gained a pret sidhi. The pret with his intuition advised him to go to hanuman tattva and shiv tattva to get his answer. He followed many pivotal saints having a great siddhi of Hanuman Ji & Shiv Ji, all the saints through their astral power connected with their “Isht devta” & adviced him that amrit siddhi can only be provided by Mahalaxmi (the puran tattva of goddess Laxmi).
On their advice and with great determination he performed a severe sadhna of mahalaxmi using tantra as a tool.

Dedication & hardwork brought him a boon where mahalaxmi appeared & gave him amrit astrally but one thing he didn’t know that all the astral bodies present in the astral world including each & every doot of every devta even rishis & maharishes were eager to have that amrit.

The time span in which he reached home all the amrit tattva were acquired by astral entities thus he was left with nothing but false hope that astral world is only a myth but this was not the end, it was a beginning of a new end.

All the energies came to him for just amrit which he lost far back. This created a loop hole where multiple energies attacked him but there was no one to protect & eventually this cause his death but after acquiring his astral body, these energies attacked his family and upcoming generations to generations passed away but yet these energies never left. From this we can say that people go but their actions & words never fades.
In his third generation & his grandson “Vidur” decided to remove this curse from his family but a curse can only be replaced by a vardaan.
Here comes the concept of Vardaan :
In this period of overcoming curse of his family he completely surrendered himself to his kuldevta that was “Mata Chamundeshwari”.
Mata Chandi herself became his guru & because of that he met saints who helped him.
Many of the prets, jinn & multiple energies removed by “Hanumanji Maharaj” energy which was indirectly guided by his grandfather A.
For this we can say that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

NOTE : The person A although he left his physical body but his astral body was still active, he indirectly on the behalf of his bhakti, he prayed to Lord Shiva to at least free his upcoming generations. His prayer act as a fuel to guide his son “Vidur”.
Vidur by the grace of his kuldevi, with in 10 years he get rid of his past ten lives karma through guided sadhanas.
The validation of his freedom from karma was given by his own negativities who itself got liberated by his jaap and acquired position in Lord Indra assembly.
The true 3 generation story of a family started with a curse and ended up with a vardaan providing moksha to his upcoming generations.
As shraap works seamlessly on the other hand vardaan also works effectively.
This is not a first example of vardaan :
Example:
When a devotee prays for vardaan his planets based on karmik bandhan plays a vital role in deciding the time span he needs to achieve the one.

Condition of Vardaan : If a guru or dev shakti has to give a vardaan / boon to anyone, so at the time of offering vardaan till the death of his mahasuksham sharir, all the karmic energies & astral energies which was once payed by the person will now be fulfilled by the guru or dev shakti hence giving a vardaan means giving a continuous energy till the end, thus it is very difficult to achieve the same.
Hence, god bestoway give his vardaan to a few, each person needs to produce different level of urja to replace their dosh & shraap.

NOTE : Generally in ashaeiynn an aspirant can get a vardaan from the guru tattva if he is able to chant guru mantra 14 crore times, this process was made by guru in the presence of bhaiya as a witness. Ashaeyein with his all means claims it true.
